description: Refurbishment of ball court to a football foundation play zone, including the installation of new fencing, lighting and surface
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of this decision.
Reason: In order to comply with Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990, as amended by Section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications: Fire Safety, Playzone Technical Design Guidance, Planning Statement, Playzone Signage Examples, Playzone Signage Dimensions, Proposed Materials Macadam PZP, Playzone Standard Design Floodlighting, Light Impact Report, DX26007 Brabazon Playzone, Flood Map for Planning, Brabazon Road BNG Metric, Brabazon Road Habitat Survey, Brabazon Road Tree Survey Report, 01 Rev. C, 02, 03 Rev. A, 04, 05, 07, 08, 09, 10, CEMP Brabazon Road Park Playzone � received 12th June 2026.
Reason: In order to ensure the development is carried out in accordance with the planning permission.
Condition : 3 - Operation of floodlights shall not be permitted during the hours of 08:00 to 22:00 Mondays to Saturdays and 09:00 to 20:00 on Sundays and Public/Bank Holidays. 
Reason: To ensure that the amenity of occupiers of the surrounding premises is not adversely light impact outside of permitted hours of use
Condition : 4 - The use of the sports facility shall not be permitted during the hours 08:00 to 22:00 Mondays to Saturdays and 09:00 to 20:00 on Sundays and Public/Bank Holidays.
Reason: To ensure that the amenity of occupiers of the surrounding premises is not adversely affected by noise from activities or people at or leaving the site.   

Condition : 5 - Floodlighting at the development site shall not be erected or operate other than in accordance with the details and specification set out within the documents Playzone Standard Design Floodlighting, Light Impact Report, DX26007 Brabazon Playzone or shall exceed lux levels of vertical illumination at neighbouring premises that are recommended by the Institution of Lighting Professionals in the 'Guidance Note 01/21: Guidance Notes for the Reduction of Obtrusive Light'. Lighting should be minimised, and glare and sky glow should be prevented by correctly using, locating, aiming, and shielding luminaires, in accordance with Guidance Notes, whichever is the lesser. 
Reason: To ensure that the amenity of occupiers of surrounding premises is not adversely affected by lighting
Condition : 6 - The development shall be undertaken in accordance with the tree protection measures detailed in the approved plan 'Tree Survey Report'. The tree protection methods shall conform to the best practise guidance contained in the British Standards BS5837: 2012 or any guidance that shall have superseded it.
Reason: In order to ensure a satisfactory appearance of the site and the area and to promote biodiversity.
Condition : 7 - Prior to occupation of the development hereby approved the applicant shall purchase 0.02 of a low distinctiveness habitat unit in order to fulfil Biodiversity net gain, as detailed in the approved plan 'UKHab 2.0 Survey Report & BNG'.  Confirmation of such shall thereafter be submitted to the Local Planning Authority. 
Reason: In the interests of biodiversity
